## Overview

The MVP is the argument surface and the grouping and composition work merged together, each feature with a diagram-following workflow per permutation ([I09:E05](https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/issues/523)). This epic proves it: one live run of those workflows on the harness and model the run names, committed beside the baseline, and the eval page stating what it proves and what it cost.

## Problem

- **No session follows a bundle built with the new features.**
  The feature workflows state each path a correct agent walks; no live session has walked one.
- **The baseline belongs to the corpus work.**
  A proof written into it would move the reference that work measures against.
- **A proof file is unexplained without the page.**
  A reader finds a run record beside the baseline and no statement of what it shows or what a rerun spends.

## Proposal

- **Design before the run.**
  `RUNBOOK.md` is written first: a triage rubric for failing sessions and a runbook for each of I10's live runs, proven by a shakedown, and the proof's shakedown on the model and harness the user names for it. The run follows its runbook and escalates what the rubric marks a defect.
- **Harness and model are chosen at the start.**
  The run's session asks which harness and which model it uses, and passes both explicitly.
- **A file of its own.**
  The run is committed as `mvp-proof.json` beside `baseline.json`, which stays untouched, and records its measured cost.
- **The page states the proof.**
  The eval page names each feature workflow and its permutations, and states what `mvp-proof.json` proves and what it cost.

## Work Breakdown

| Task | Description | Coverage | Depends on | Joins | Done |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [W00](https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/pull/596) | Write the runbook and triage rubric | AC6, AC7, AC8 | | | ✓ |
| [W01](https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/pull/620) | Run the live default-matrix proof | AC1, AC2, AC3 | [I09:E05](https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/issues/523), W00, W03 | | ✓ |
| [W02](https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/pull/624) | State the proof on the eval page | AC4, AC5 | W01 | |✓ |
| [W03](https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/pull/615) | Record managed configuration by count and fingerprint | AC9 | W00 | | ✓ |
| [W04](https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/pull/629) | Count managed hooks from the transcripts | AC10 | W03 | | ✓ |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] **AC1.** `evals/diagram-following/mvp-proof.json` records one live run over the feature workflows, naming the harness and model it ran on, across every form that harness runs in the default matrix, and gives every failing session the triage rubric's disposition, as the file's run record shows.
- [x] **AC2.** Every feature scenario passes every run in at least one form cell, and no cell of the proof run passes no run, as `mvp-proof.json` shows.
- [x] **AC3.** The proof run leaves `evals/diagram-following/baseline.json` unchanged, as its pull request's changed files show.
- [x] **AC4.** The eval page names each feature workflow and the permutations its scenarios cover, as a read of the page against `workflows/` shows.
- [x] **AC5.** The eval page states what `mvp-proof.json` proves and the run's measured cost, matching the cost the file records, as the page and the file show.
- [x] **AC6.** `evals/diagram-following/RUNBOOK.md`'s triage rubric gives, for each class the scorer defines and `errored`, the evidence that marks a failing session an agent miss, a scenario or harness defect, or unclear, and the action a run takes for each, as a read of the rubric against the scorer shows.
- [x] **AC7.** `RUNBOOK.md` gives the MVP proof, the baseline and the edge run each a runbook stating its command and arguments, model, harnesses, forms, token budget, cost cap, stop rules and committed files, each argument one `run.py` accepts, as a read of the runbooks against `run.py --help` shows.
- [x] **AC8.** The proof's runbook carries a shakedown on the model and harness the user named for it, recorded with them, whose measured cost sets its budget, as `RUNBOOK.md` shows.
- [x] **AC9.** A run record and its report state how many managed plugins, managed environment settings and managed hooks the sessions carried and a fingerprint of that configuration, naming none of them, and no document or test in the eval names a managed configuration's plugin, version or setting, as stub-agent tests `make check` runs and a search of `evals/` show.
- [x] **AC10.** A run record and its report count the managed hooks from the hook events the session transcripts show, never their content, and `mvp-proof.json` counts the SessionStart hook every proof session carried, as stub-agent tests `make check` runs and the proof record recounted from its transcripts show.

## References

- **R1.** [Planning record](https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/tree/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-01-464-i10-evaluation-and-checks) — the work items and the decision that moved the proof here.
- **R2.** [Grouping and composition record](https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/tree/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-02-463-i09-grouping-and-composition) — the feature workflows, the pass bar and the proof's earlier decisions.
